verdict.rationale: Mintlify's first-party docs describe an AI chat assistant added to the docs site that answers reader questions and cites sources, with links to relevant content. Supporting docs cover embedding the assistant via the REST API, analytics on assistant conversations, and credit pricing for assistant answers. A community comment independently confirms the AI assistant exists as a Mintlify feature. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on verification of citation accuracy and grounding quality.
